judgment.rationale: Reuse the existing recovery path and reproduce on a current build before designing a new WPF fix. The historical stack alone does not establish a current unhandled route, and a general catch/swallow change is not justified.
evidence: The supplied 0.94.2 stack has COMException 0x80263001 through DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea and WPF theme/backdrop handling.
